scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
^FF0000Chicken Eggs^000000! Come and
buy as many Chicken Eggs
as you want, whenever you
want! Hey buddy, you wanna
take a look at the Chicken
Eggs that I'm selling?
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
^FF0000雞蛋^000000！快來買呀，想買多少就買多少，隨時都能買！
嘿，朋友，要不要看看我賣的雞蛋？

scripts.text: What are you doing?
scripts.translation: 你在做什麼？

scripts.text: Why Chicken Eggs?
scripts.translation: 為什麼是雞蛋？

scripts.text: Sure, I'll buy some.
scripts.translation: 好，我買一些

scripts.text: Never mind.
scripts.translation: 算了

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
What am I--? I'm
selling Chicken Eggs!
For this special event
period, I'm selling as many
Chicken Eggs as you could
want for only 500 zeny each!
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
我在做什麼？當然是在賣雞蛋！
活動期間，想買多少都行，每個只要500 Zeny！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Boys, girls, friends,
family, old people, young
people, um, maybe not most
vegetarians or raw foodists,
but almost everyone likes eggs!
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
不管是男孩女孩、親朋好友，還是老人年輕人，幾乎人人都愛吃雞蛋！
嗯...大多數素食主義者和生食主義者可能不算。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Can you imagine a world
without eggs? There'd be
no bread, pastries, cake
or frosting... Ice cream
would be a lot runnier...
Pranks wouldn't be as fun...
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
能想像沒有雞蛋的世界嗎？
就沒有面包、糕點、蛋糕，也沒有糖霜...
冰淇淋會稀得多，惡作劇也沒那麼好玩了...

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
I'm not really sure why, but
Chicken Eggs are popular
around this time of year.
They're hot items right
now, and I aim to cash in!
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
我也不知道為什麼，每年這個時候雞蛋都特別受歡迎。
現在賣得正火，我當然要趁機賺一筆！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Great! How many do you
want? Remember that each
Chicken Egg is 500 zeny.
Remember that you won't
always be able to buy
Chicken Eggs so easily!
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
好！要多少個？每個500 Zeny。
可不是隨時都能這麼方便地買到雞蛋哦！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, if you're not
going to buy anything,
then would you mind getting
out of the way so I can
help out my customers?
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
嘿，不買的話，麻煩讓一讓，我還得招呼其他客人呢。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, you mind giving
me a real number? I also
can't sell you more than
1,000 Chicken Eggs at a time,
you know. C'mon, tell me how
many you want for real now.
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
嘿，能不能報個靠譜的數量？
一次最多賣1,000個雞蛋。
說吧，到底要多少？

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
You don't have enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
你的Zeny不足。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
No discount, go and get enough Zeny.
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
不打折，去湊夠Zeny吧。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Hey, I know you really
want to buy some Chicken
Eggs, but you won't be able
to carry that much now. Why
don't you free up some
Inventory space first?.
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
我知道你想買雞蛋，可你現在放不下這麼多。
先騰出些物品欄空間吧。

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Here's your Chicken Eggs!
I guess there's some festival
happening where you'll need
them, but I don't know anything
about that. Well, have a good
time, and I'll see you again!
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
雞蛋給你！
大概有什麼節慶要用到它們吧，不過我也不清楚。
玩得開心，下次再見！

scripts.text:
[Egg Salesman]
Not interested in buying
Chicken Eggs, huh? Well,
word's going around that
there's some kind of festival
where they'll come in handy...
Can you really pass this up?
scripts.translation:
[賣蛋人]
不想買雞蛋啊？
聽說有個節慶正好要用到它們...
真要錯過這個機會？

scripts.text:
[Dowdy Matron]
This festival is going
to be so much fun! Ooh!
I should buy some Chicken
Eggs to make some decorations.
scripts.translation:
[土氣的主婦]
這個節慶一定很好玩！
哦！得買些雞蛋來做裝飾。

scripts.text:
[Dowdy Matron]
Speaking of which,
I've heard the nun that
can make Holy Eggs is back
in Prontera. Though, I think
she's using Chicken Eggs rather
than regular Eggs to make them.
scripts.translation:
[土氣的主婦]
說起來，聽說那位會做聖蛋的修女又回到普隆德拉了。
不過，她現在好像用的是雞蛋，不是普通的蛋。

scripts.text:
[Cantankerous Geezer]
.Hey, do you know how
Chicken Eggs got to be so
expensive? I mean, 500 zeny
is a lot! I think it's because
some guy in Morocc is trying
to amass a ton of Holy Eggs!
scripts.translation:
[脾氣古怪的老頭]
嘿，知道雞蛋怎麼變得這麼貴嗎？
一個500 Zeny，可不便宜！
我看是夢羅克有個傢伙想囤一大堆聖蛋，才鬧成這樣的！

scripts.text:
[Cantankerous Geezer]
I don't know what he's
offering for those Holy
Eggs, but adventurers are
coming to him with Holy Eggs
in droves. I wonder what he's
giving to them in return?
scripts.translation:
[脾氣古怪的老頭]
不知道他拿什麼換聖蛋，冒險者們卻成群結隊地帶著聖蛋去找他。
到底能換到什麼呢？

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Hello! If you'd like,
I can take your Chicken
Eggs and transform them
into Holy Eggs. It's something
I do for others in celebration
of this holy season.
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
你好！你願意的話，我可以把雞蛋變成聖蛋。
這是我為慶祝這個神聖的節日，給大家提供的幫助。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Holy Eggs represent
rebirth and, fittingly,
can be used to restore
life to your friends.
Would you like me to
make some for you?
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
聖蛋象徵重生，也確實能讓你的朋友起死回生。
需要我幫你做一些嗎？

scripts.text: What do I need to make Holy Eggs?
scripts.translation: 製作聖蛋需要什麼材料？

scripts.text: I want to make Holy Eggs.
scripts.translation: 我想製作聖蛋

scripts.text: Maybe next time.
scripts.translation: 下次再說

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
For each Holy Egg
that you want me to
make, you will need
to bring me...
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
每製作一枚聖蛋，需要帶來...

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
^4D4DFF1 White Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Green Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Holy Water^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Chicken Egg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
^4D4DFF1個白色藥草^000000
^4D4DFF1個綠色藥草^000000
^4D4DFF1個黃色藥草^000000
^4D4DFF1個聖水^000000
^4D4DFF1個雞蛋^000000

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Alright, how many
Holy Eggs would you
like me to make you?
I can only make up to
10 Holy Eggs at a time.
Enter ''0'' to cancel.
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
要做多少枚聖蛋？
一次最多10枚。
輸入0取消。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Oh, you changed your
mind? Feel free to visit me
whenever you want me to
make you some Holy Eggs~
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
哦，您改變主意了？
隨時歡迎回來找我製作聖蛋哦~

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but I can only
make up to 10 Holy Eggs
at a time. If you wanted to
cancel, then just enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
抱歉，一次最多隻能做10枚聖蛋。
想取消的話，輸入0就好。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but you don't
have enough items to make
Holy Eggs. You need the
following for me to create
each Holy Egg for you.
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
抱歉，您的材料不足，無法制作聖蛋。
製作每一枚聖蛋都需要以下材料。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
^4D4DFF1 White Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Green Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Yellow Herb^000000,
^4D4DFF1 Holy Water^000000, and
^4D4DFF1 Chicken Egg^000000.
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
^4D4DFF1個白色藥草^000000
^4D4DFF1個綠色藥草^000000
^4D4DFF1個黃色藥草^000000
^4D4DFF1個聖水^000000
^4D4DFF1個雞蛋^000000

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
I'm sorry, but you
won't be able to carry
that many Holy Eggs now...
You'd better free up more
space in your Inventory first.
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
抱歉，你現在放不下這麼多聖蛋...
先騰出些物品欄空間吧。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Thank you!
I hope you enjoy
these Holy Eggs~
Hope you to be with God's love.
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
謝謝！希望這些聖蛋能幫到你~
願神的愛與你同在。

scripts.text:
[Nerlen]
Alright, I understand.
May God bless you.
scripts.translation:
[內爾倫]
好的，我明白了。
願上帝保佑您。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
How are you doing?
Death... It's inescapable.
Even you'll die someday. But...
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
你好嗎？
死亡...是無法逃避的。
你終有一天也會死去。但是...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Oh, yes. That's it.
You have it. The egg you
hold has a secret power.
I think that... Yes. Someone
like you would understand
us, fit well into our group.
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
哦，沒錯，就是它。
你手中的蛋蘊藏著神秘力量。
我想...對，像你這樣的人，一定能理解我們，也很適合加入我們的組織。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Why don't
you... Join us?
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
何不...加入我們？

scripts.text: What for?
scripts.translation: 為了什麼？

scripts.text: Um... But you're suspicious!
scripts.translation: 嗯...但你們很可疑！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
I see I've caught your
interest! Well, if you'd
like to join us and learn
more, then why don't you
bring me 10 Holy Eggs?
That is my condition.
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
看來你感興趣了！
想加入我們、瞭解更多的話，帶10枚聖蛋來吧。
這是我的條件。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Really? Well, I suppose
I can't help it. Let me
assure you that our
organization works
for the greater good.
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
是嗎？那也沒辦法。
不過我可以保證，我們的組織是為了更崇高的善而行動。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We should all enjoy
life while we still can.
Who knows? Perhaps
there will be other lives
to live after this one.
Perhaps, perhaps....
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
趁還能享受生活，我們都該好好活著。
誰知道呢？這一生結束後，也許還有來生。
也許吧，也許...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, you have returned.
Did you still wish to
join our ranks? If so,
I hope you brought the
10 Holy Eggs I require.
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
啊，你回來了。
還想加入我們嗎？想的話，希望你已經帶齊了10枚聖蛋。

scripts.text: Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 交出聖蛋

scripts.text: Don't Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 不交出聖蛋

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
So you do wish to
join our organization.
First, let me check if you
brought the Holy Eggs...
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
看來你是真的想加入我們的組織了。
首先，讓我檢查一下你是否帶來了聖蛋...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Very well. In return
for these Holy Eggs, let
me give you a small present
for joining us. Now, I can
tell you about what we do.
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
很好，收下這些聖蛋後，我會送你一份加入組織的小禮物。
現在，可以告訴你我們在做什麼了。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
^333333*Cough Cough*^000000
Excuse me, I've got--
^333333*Cough!*^000000 A... A bit of a
sore throat. Give me a sec...

[Corps Member]
Hm. You don't have enough
Holy Eggs to meet the condition
I set for you. Did you leave
them in your Storage?
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
嗯，聖蛋數量不夠，沒達到我提出的條件。
是不是放在倉庫裡了？

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Hm? I suppose I can't
blame you for being a bit
suspicious of us. Let me
assure you that ours is
a mission of holiness.
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
嗯？你對我們有些懷疑，也不能怪你。
不過我可以保證，我們的使命是神聖的。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We are an organization
that is dedicated to...
Resurrecting dead heroes!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
我們是一個致力於...
復活已故英雄的組織！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Those Holy Eggs that you've
brought have the power to
restore life to the dead.
In large quantities...
They can even revive
ancient fallen heroes!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
你帶來的聖蛋能讓死者重獲生命。
數量足夠的話...甚至能復活遠古逝去的英雄！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
When you bring me
33 Holy Eggs, I will
enchant them so that you
can use them on areas where
ancient heroes had died.
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
帶33枚聖蛋來，我就給它們附魔。
這樣，你就能在遠古英雄死去的地方使用它們。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go and bring me
33 Holy Eggs! I shall be
waiting here for your return...
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
去吧，給我帶來33枚聖蛋！
我會在這裡等待你的歸來...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, you've returned
Now, did you bring me
33 Holy Eggs for your task?
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
啊，你回來了。
任務要用的33枚聖蛋，帶來了嗎？

scripts.text: Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 交出聖蛋

scripts.text: Don't Give Holy Eggs
scripts.translation: 不交出聖蛋

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, these will do!
Now, make a note of the
destination I describe as
I infuse these Holy Eggs
with additional magic.
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
啊，這些就夠了！
我給聖蛋注入額外魔力的時候，你把我說的目的地記下來。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
You must go to the
entrance of Payon Dungeon,
where a nimble hero has fallen.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs there,
and then return to me. Now...
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
前往斐揚迷宮入口，一位身手敏捷的英雄在那裡死去。
在那兒獻上聖蛋，然後回來找我。
去吧，讓他重獲生命！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to the 3rd level of
Izlude dungeon... A hero.
that sought wisdom perished
at the entrance to the 4th
level. Sacrifice the Holy Eggs
there, and return him to life!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
去依斯魯得島迷宮第3層...
一位追求智慧的英雄，死在通往第4層的入口。
在那裡獻上聖蛋，讓他復活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to the abandoned mine
dungeon where a brave hero
died to protect his comrades.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs as soon
as you get to the 3rd floor.
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
前往廢棄礦洞迷宮，一位英勇的英雄曾為保護同伴而死在那裡。
一到第3層，就獻上聖蛋。
去吧，讓他重獲生命！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to Glastheim, and
sacrifice the Holy Eggs
as soon as you enter the
2nd floor. A hero perished
there, but you shall bring
him back to the living!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
前往葛拉斯特海姆，進入第2層後就獻上聖蛋。
一位英雄在那裡死去，你要讓他重返人間！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Hm? This isn't
33 Holy Eggs. Did you
leave some in your Storage?
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
嗯？聖蛋不夠33枚。
是不是有一些放在倉庫裡了？

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Don't you understand
the righteousness of
our cause? Returning fallen
heroes will bring peace to
our lands much more quickly!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
你還不明白我們做的事有多正義嗎？
讓逝去的英雄復活，這片土地就能更快迎來和平！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Did you forget
where you must go?
Let me remind you
so that you do not
lose your way...
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
忘了該去哪裡嗎？
我再告訴你一遍，免得走錯...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
You must go to the
entrance of Payon Dungeon,
where a nimble hero has fallen.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs there,
and then return to me. Now...
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
[軍團成員]
前往斐揚迷宮入口，一位身手敏捷的英雄在那裡死去。
在那兒獻上聖蛋，然後回來找我。
去吧，讓他重獲生命！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
Go to the 3rd level of
Izlude dungeon... A hero.
that sought wisdom perished
at the entrance to the 4th
level. Sacrifice the Holy Eggs
there, and return him to life!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
[軍團成員]
去依斯魯得島迷宮第3層...
一位追求智慧的英雄，死在通往第4層的入口。
在那裡獻上聖蛋，讓他復活！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
[Corps Member]
Go to the abandoned mine
dungeon where a brave hero
died to protect his comrades.
Sacrifice the Holy Eggs as soon
as you get to the 3rd floor.
Go, and bring him back to life!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
[軍團成員]
前往廢棄礦洞迷宮，一位英勇的英雄曾為保護同伴而死在那裡。
一到第3層，就獻上聖蛋。
去吧，讓他重獲生命！

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Go to Glastheim, and
sacrifice the Holy Eggs
as soon as you enter the
2nd floor. A hero perished
there, but you shall bring
him back to the living!
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
前往葛拉斯特海姆，進入第2層後就獻上聖蛋。
一位英雄在那裡死去，你要讓他重返人間！

scripts.text: [Corps Member]
scripts.translation: [軍團成員]

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Ah, I hope you've come
back with good news.
So did it work?
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
啊，希望你帶來的是好訊息。
成功了嗎？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Actually...
Nothing happened....
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
其實...
什麼也沒發生...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
What? It can't be.
The magic... It should
have been powerful enough...
Well, it's too bad that we
failed. Even so, I am grateful
for all your help thus far...
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
什麼？不可能。
魔法...應該足夠強才對...
可惜，我們失敗了。
不過，還是很感謝你一直以來的幫助...

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
We'll investigate what
could have gone wrong,
and then try again next year.
Farewell, my friend, and I hope
that you'll assist us again.
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
我們會查清哪裡出了問題，明年再試一次。
再見，朋友，希望到時候你還願意幫忙。

scripts.text:
[Corps Member]
Shh! Tell no one
that I am here.
scripts.translation:
[軍團成員]
噓！別告訴別人我在這裡。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Well...
This is the place
the Corps Member
wanted me to find...
Time to use all of
these Holy Eggs.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
嗯...這就是軍團成員讓我找的地方...
該把這些聖蛋全用掉了。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Here we go...
Will this really bring
this ancient hero
back to life? I'm...
I'm kind of scared!
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
開始吧...
真的能讓這位遠古英雄復活嗎？
我...我有點害怕！

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^333333*Whew!*^000000 Nothing happened!
I guess I better go back to
that Corps Member and let
him know that it didn't work.
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^333333*呼！*^000000 什麼也沒發生！
還是回去告訴那位軍團成員，沒成功吧。

scripts.text:
[{0}]
Huh? Where did I put
those 33 Holy Eggs
that I needed for this?
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
咦？要用的33枚聖蛋，我放哪兒了？

scripts.text:
[{0}]
There was something
here, but I can't tell
for sure what it was...
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
這裡好像曾經有什麼東西，可說不準是什麼...
